name: Holder thank-you drop
description: Sends a small BSV thank-you to a fixed list of addresses you write into sendTo (for example your top holders or contributors). 50 cents each, at most $5 a day and $20 in total. It sends BSV, not tokens: token airdrops are not something strategies can do yet. Replace the placeholders before loading. Sending is final.
goals: Send $0.50 of BSV to each address on the send list, once each. Skip anyone already paid (check Activity). Never send to an address not on the list.

spec.trades: BSV only, to the addresses in its list
spec.needs: Your list of addresses in sendTo before loading
